description: This file defines a class for validating HTML length attributes, specifically handling pixel values and percentage values for certain HTML attributes within an HTML purifier library.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_HTML_Length
classes.description: A class extending HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_HTML_Pixels that validates length attributes as either pixels or percentages, ensuring they fall within valid ranges.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a string as a length attribute, accepting pixel values or percentages, and normalizing out-of-range values.
